text: To reset your PIN, go to Settings > Security > Change PIN and follow the on-screen steps. A new PIN takes effect immediately.
If your card is lost or stolen, freeze it immediately from the app under Cards > Freeze card, then order a replacement.
To dispute a transaction, open the transaction in your history and tap Dispute, then answer the prompts to submit a claim.
Monthly account fees are waived when you maintain a minimum balance of 500 dollars or receive a qualifying direct deposit.
Daily spending limits can be viewed and adjusted under Settings > Card limits. Increases are subject to review.
